purpose: all three Stage-2 training conditions on one page

read_me_first.pooled_auc_is_not_the_headline: Zero non-holdout series contains both classes, so pooled AUC can be reached by recognizing batch signature. Within-series AUC cannot.
read_me_first.loss_floor_is_not_evidence: condition 3 adds an easy one-bit target, so a lower floor is mixture arithmetic, not representation quality
